title: Intro to Programming
description: This introductory course develops foundational programming skills in Python. Learners are introduced to core concepts such as variables, data types, loops, functions, and basic syntax, enabling them to write simple programs and complete basic coding tasks.

competencies.description: Programming is the ability to write, understand, and troubleshoot code to complete structured data and automation tasks. indicators: Write basic programs that include variables, loops, conditionals, and functions to perform simple data tasks.
Recognize and correct common programming errors, such as syntax and logical mistakes.

title: Python
description: This introductory course develops foundational Python programming skills for data science. Learners practice core syntax, variables, functions, conditionals, loops, lists, strings, dictionaries, and the use of external libraries through tutorials and exercises.

competencies.description: Programming is the ability to write, understand, and troubleshoot code to perform data-related tasks. At the foundational level, it includes using core language features, basic data structures, and common libraries to manipulate data and build simple programs.

title: Data Cleaning
description: This beginner-level course introduces practical techniques for cleaning messy real-world datasets in Python.
